Title: Retirement: Azure Spring Apps will be retired on March 31, 2028

Body.Content:
Following the retirement announcement of Azure Spring Apps, we would like to share an important update regarding the retirement of Azure Spring Apps Basic, Standard and Enterprise plans.   

On March 17, 2025, Azure Spring Apps Basic, Standard and Enterprise plans will enter a 3-year sunset period and will be retired on March 31, 2028. After March 31, 2028, Azure Spring Apps Basic, Standard and Enterprise plans won’t be supported, and your Azure Spring Apps instances will no longer be accessible after that date. 

New customers will no longer be able to sign up for the service after March 17, 2025; existing customers will remain operational until the plans are phased out on March 31, 2028.  

To ensure you maintain a high performance and achieve scalability, flexibility, and cost-efficiency for your business, we recommend Azure Container Apps and Azure Kubernetes Service as the alternative services for your migration of workloads running on Azure Spring Apps.  

Required action:  

We are committed to supporting you and your customers with migration tools, expert resources, and technical support through this transition. To avoid any service disruptions, we recommend you transition to Azure Container Apps or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) by March 31, 2028. 

Help and Support:  

If you have questions, please open a support ticket through the Azure portal for technical help. 

Learn more.
